percentages.title: Percentages - Formulas & Shortcut Rules
percentages.description: Essential formulas for percentage calculations, base changes, and expenditure rules.

formulas.name: Basic Percentage
formulas.equation: Percentage = (Part / Whole) × 100

formulas.name: Percentage Increase / Decrease
formulas.equation: % Change = [(Final Value - Initial Value) / Initial Value] × 100

formulas.name: Price Increase vs Consumption Reduction
formulas.equation: Reduction % = [ r / (100 + r) ] × 100%
formulas.example: Price rises by 25%: [25 / (100 + 25)] × 100% = 20% consumption reduction required

formulas.name: Successive Percentage Change
formulas.equation: Net % Change = A + B + (A × B / 100)

shortcuts: Base Shift Rule: If A is r% more than B, B is [r / (100 + r)] × 100% less than A.

profit-and-loss.title: Profit & Loss - Formulas & Short Tricks
profit-and-loss.description: Formulas for Cost Price (CP), Selling Price (SP), Marked Price (MP), and Discounts.

formulas.name: Profit & Loss %
formulas.equation: Profit % = (Profit / CP) × 100 | Loss % = (Loss / CP) × 100

formulas.name: Selling Price Formula
formulas.equation: SP = CP × [ (100 ± Profit/Loss %) / 100 ]

formulas.name: Discount & Marked Price
formulas.equation: SP = MP × [ (100 - Discount %) / 100 ]

formulas.name: Dishonest Dealer Shortcut
formulas.equation: Gain % = [ Error / (True Value - Error) ] × 100%

shortcuts: When 2 items are sold at same SP, one at x% profit and another at x% loss, overall loss % = (x / 10)² %.

ratio-and-proportion.title: Ratio & Proportion - Fundamental Rules
ratio-and-proportion.description: Rules for combining ratios, finding mean proportionals, and partnership shares.

formulas.name: Proportion Rule
formulas.equation: If a:b = c:d, then a × d = b × c (Product of Extremes = Product of Means)

formulas.name: Mean & Third Proportional
formulas.equation: Mean Proportional of a and b = √(a × b) | Third Proportional of a and b = b² / a

formulas.name: Dividing a Sum
formulas.equation: Share of A in (A+B) = [ a / (a + b) ] × Total Sum

shortcuts: To combine A:B = 2:3 and B:C = 4:5, multiply A:B by 4 and B:C by 3 => A:B:C = 8:12:15.

time-and-work.title: Time & Work - Efficiency & LCM Shortcuts
time-and-work.description: Work rates, joint efficiency, and pipes & cisterns calculations.

formulas.name: Work Rate Formula
formulas.equation: Work = Rate × Time => 1 Day Work = 1 / Total Days
formulas.example: If A completes in 10 days, 1 day work = 1/10

formulas.name: Joint Work Together
formulas.equation: Combined Time = (A × B) / (A + B)
formulas.example: A takes 12 days, B takes 6 days => Together = (12 × 6) / (12 + 6) = 72 / 18 = 4 days

formulas.name: Men, Days & Hours Rule
formulas.example: 10 men do 1 work in 6 days => How many men do same work in 4 days? (10 × 6) = M2 × 4 => M2 = 15

shortcuts: LCM Method: Set Total Work = LCM(Days). Find daily efficiency units for instant mental calculation.

speed-and-distance.title: Speed, Time & Distance - Core Formulas
speed-and-distance.description: Unit conversions, relative speed, train problems, and average speed.

formulas.name: Basic Speed Equation
formulas.equation: Speed = Distance / Time | Distance = Speed × Time
formulas.example: Covering 180 km in 3 hours => Speed = 180 / 3 = 60 km/h

formulas.name: Average Speed (Equal Distances)
formulas.equation: Avg Speed = (2 × S1 × S2) / (S1 + S2)
formulas.example: Going at 40 km/h and returning at 60 km/h => Avg = (2 × 40 × 60) / 100 = 48 km/h

formulas.name: Relative Speed
formulas.equation: Opposite Directions = S1 + S2 | Same Direction = |S1 - S2|
formulas.example: Trains at 50 km/h and 30 km/h moving towards each other => Relative Speed = 80 km/h

shortcuts: If speed ratio is A:B for equal distance, time ratio is B:A.

interest.title: Simple & Compound Interest - Quick Formulas
interest.description: SI, CI compounding formulas, and difference shortcuts.

formulas.name: Simple Interest (SI)
formulas.equation: SI = (P × R × T) / 100 | Amount A = P + SI

formulas.name: Compound Interest (CI)
formulas.equation: Amount A = P × [ 1 + (R / 100) ]^T | CI = A - P

formulas.name: Difference between CI and SI for 2 Years
formulas.equation: CI - SI = P × (R / 100)²

shortcuts: Rule of 72: Money doubles in approximately (72 / R) years at R% compound interest.

syllogisms.title: Syllogisms - Logical Deduction Rules
syllogisms.description: Venn diagram representations and standard deduction rules.

formulas.name: Universal Affirmative (All A are B)
formulas.equation: Diagram: A is inside B (A ⊂ B). Valid conversions: Some B are A.
formulas.example: All cats are mammals => Some mammals are cats.

formulas.name: Universal Negative (No A is B)
formulas.equation: Diagram: Completely separate circles (A ∩ B = ∅). Valid conversion: No B is A.
formulas.example: No dog is a bird => No bird is a dog.

formulas.name: Either-Or Condition
formulas.equation: 1. Both conclusions individual false. 2. One affirmative, one negative. 3. Same subject/predicate.
formulas.example: Conclusion 1: Some A are B. Conclusion 2: No A is B.

shortcuts: A conclusion must hold true in ALL valid Venn diagram representations to be correct.

sentence-correction.title: Verbal Ability - Grammar & Sentence Correction Rules
sentence-correction.description: Key subject-verb agreement, pronoun, and modifier rules.

formulas.name: Subject-Verb Agreement
formulas.equation: Singular Subject -> Singular Verb ('has', 'is', 'was'). Plural -> Plural Verb ('have', 'are').
formulas.example: Each of the students HAS (not have) completed the test.

formulas.name: Correlative Conjunction Pairs
formulas.equation: Either...or | Neither...nor | Hardly...when | Scarcely...when | No sooner...than
formulas.example: Hardly had he arrived WHEN (not than) it started raining.

formulas.name: Parallelism Rule
formulas.equation: Items in a list or comparison must use the same grammatical form.
formulas.example: He likes swimming, running, and CYCLING (not to cycle).
